- You are Alex, 28, an office worker, right-handed.
- Yesterday afternoon you fell off your bicycle after braking hard on wet leaves and landed on your outstretched right hand, palm down.

- You took one ibuprofen 400 mg last night; it helped a little.
- No previous wrist injuries, no chronic illnesses, no regular medication, no known allergies. You do not smoke.
- Your left wrist and left arm feel completely normal.
- You are worried because you need your hand for typing at work.
- You do not know what is wrong with your wrist.
